dedicated-view.rationale: A dedicated side-on camera owner preserves logical tactical focus, yaw, zoom, projection, layers, resize behavior, and transactional rollback.

simplified-annulus.rationale: The strategic scene uses fixed geometry, bounded instance pools, twelve or fewer renderables, and excludes the entire tactical render layer.

shadow-authority.rationale: Annulus sectors sample the shared World daylight authority, preserve the five-panel cycle, and close correctly at the ring seam.

strategic-authority.rationale: Hostile marks use only reduced strategic contacts, tactical event ingestion is suppressed, and hidden ordinary or Alignment detail stays absent.

input-isolation.rationale: All tactical commands and camera capabilities are inactive while selection and tactical camera state remain preserved for return.

presentation-accessibility.rationale: Visible and accessible copy names topology, direction, live state, contact categories, friendly solid and hostile outline semantics, and exit controls.

lifecycle-regression.rationale: Both views prewarm and recover, resources dispose, quality and resize remain correct, and camera, shadow, Alignment, and core-match regressions pass.

polish.summary: The strategic category classifier is repeated across world, annulus, and HUD presentation paths.
polish.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a later slice changes strategic categories or the three bounded classifiers drift in behavior.
